items.title: Sira,an AI native flight booking experience
items.raw_excerpt: Sira is a chat-first flight booking interface built on top of published airline fares. You describe the trip in plain English, and Sira returns normalized options instantly. The price shown is the final price — no added service fees or checkout upsells. We surface published fares directly rather than consolidator inventory, and we keep the flow intentionally minimal. The goal is to reduce friction between intent and booking. Under the hood, we reconcile availability and pricing from standard distribution channels and present a simplified booking layer on top. Would love feedback from anyone who has worked with airline distribution or built in travel.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 得益于一次性反编译的快速进展，《滑雪小子2》的反编译工作起初进展迅速，但随后开始放缓。本文探讨了工作流程的演变、工具改进以及由此显现出的基础大语言模型局限性。
excerpt_i18n.es: Tras los rápidos avances gracias a la descompilación en un solo paso, el progreso en la descompilación de Snowboard Kids 2 comenzó a flaquear. Esta entrada explora la evolución del flujo de trabajo, las mejoras en las herramientas y los límites fundamentales de los LLM que surgieron.
